# ScribeCat 0.24.1

ScribeCat 0.24.1 polishes the new multi-document workflow with a more flexible desktop split view, better tabs, and faster two-file actions from the vault.

## Split view: work from either side

- Open a second Markdown document on the **left or right**.
- Drag a file or an open tab toward either half of the editor and get a clear half-screen drop preview before releasing.
- Use the **swap control on the center divider** to exchange the left and right documents.
- Resize the panes with the divider.
- Close either pane with **×** and keep the remaining document open normally.
- Replace either split document without rebuilding the split from scratch.
- The edge **+** controls stay hidden until you hover the corresponding side.
- Fixes layout corruption that could occur after swapping panes and then opening or replacing another document.

![Illustrative split view preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reidar96/scribecat/main/docs/releases/0.24.1/split-view.svg)

## Tabs: easier document switching

- Keep multiple Markdown documents open as tabs.
- **Drag tabs to reorder them**.
- Drag a tab into the left or right split target to open it beside the current document.
- Close individual tabs with **×**.
- Use **Close all tabs** on both desktop and mobile.
- Mobile tabs now stay in a stable horizontal bar below the header instead of expanding into the document area.
- Unsaved drafts remain in ScribeCat's document cache when tabs are closed.

![Illustrative tabs preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reidar96/scribecat/main/docs/releases/0.24.1/tabs.svg)

## Open two selected notes together

When exactly two Markdown documents are selected in the sidebar or File Viewer, the context menu now includes:

- **Open selected in split view**
- **Open selected as tabs**

Folder selections are excluded from these document actions.

![Illustrative two-file context menu preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reidar96/scribecat/main/docs/releases/0.24.1/context-actions.svg)

> The images above are illustrative UI previews of the 0.24.1 features, not pixel-for-pixel screenshots from a running desktop build.

## Downloads

Use the assets attached to this release for Windows and Linux. The versioned multi-architecture ScribeCat server image is also published through GHCR.
